_comment: The Kingdom of Kerma (Kush to the Egyptians) at the start, 1 January 1800 BC: the first Nubian state, ruled from the great city of Kerma below the Third Cataract and holding the Dongola Reach to the Fourth; Egypt's rival and trading partner across the Second Cataract forts. Its kings are generated (none are known by name).
name: Kerma

start_provinces._comment: chiefs of the Abu Hamed reach drawn into the kingdom
